prima_scriptura.name: Prima Scriptura
prima_scriptura.desc: While the Holy Scripture has to be considered the central source of salvation, it can not be considered the only source of divine revelation.

five_doors.name: The Five Doors
five_doors.desc: Some among our people practice a meditation style consisting in closing all the doors in a house while opening the five doors or the five senses. We will introduce this practice everywhere.

holy_cooperation.name: Holy Cooperation
holy_cooperation.desc: A shift will occur towards promoting and actively participating in productive work. This ethos will extend to our agricultural communities, inspired by the early Christians' model of a sacred cooperative community.

twelve_emissaries.name: The Twelve Emissaries
twelve_emissaries.desc: Inspired by the organization of some communities, we will elect among our elders and perfect ones twelve wise men to act as a supreme council, without creating a true hierarchy.

arminianism.name: Arminianism
arminianism.desc: Arminianism is based on the pluralistic and humanitarian ideas of the Dutch Reformed theologian Jacobus Arminius.

gomarism.name: Gomarism
gomarism.desc: Franciscus Gomarus opposes the beliefs of Jacobus Arminius who taught Pelagian doctrines and tried to create a new school of theology within the university where the two of them taught.

instituionalized_arminianism.name: Institutionalized Arminianism
instituionalized_arminianism.desc: Arminianism is based on the pluralistic and humanitarian ideas of the Dutch Reformed theologian Jacobus Arminius. This religious movement is now institutionalized within our state.

instituionalized_gomarism.name: Institutionalized Gomarism
instituionalized_gomarism.desc: Franciscus Gomarus opposes the beliefs of Jacobus Arminius who taught Pelagian doctrines and tried to create a new school of theology within the university where the two of them taught. This religious movement is now institutionalized within our state.

consolamentum.name: Consolamentum
consolamentum.desc: As the process of living incurs, inevitably, in regret for our sins, the need to receive a consolation to enter Heaven pure and move closer to God becomes obvious. By receiving the Consolamentum, our people are absolved of their sins upon impending death,

pescatarianism.name: Pescatarianism
pescatarianism.desc: Animals are carriers of reincarnated souls, and because of that we cannot eat them. Fishes, beings pontaneously generated, cannot be considered animals and can be eaten.

the_perfects.name: The Perfects
the_perfects.desc: Those among us that are specially commited to God and the virtues all human should pursue are called Perfects. These men and women receive Consolamentum for their devotion and become Perfects. Contrary to regular folks, Perfects receive Consolamentum twice in their lifes: when they are elevated to their new role and before dying.

adoptionism.name: Adoptionism
adoptionism.desc: Our belief posits that Jesus Christ became God's Son at his baptism or resurrection, rather than being eternally divine.

adult_baptism.name: Adult Baptism
adult_baptism.desc: Being baptized as an adult on the basis of profession of faith in Jesus Christ and as admission into a local community of faith is made by those who believe that saving grace and Church membership are gifts from God. The recipient's faith must be vocalized and cannot be imparted or transferred from one person to another.

aniconism.name: Aniconism
aniconism.desc: Symbols are not a proper way to represent our Lord, as they are means to represent idols or people. We will reject any representation, including the cross used by other Christians.

asceticism.name: Asceticism
asceticism.desc: Materialistic pursuits blind us to the divine truth. Only by devoting ourselves to live simple lives without luxury can we achieve spiritual enlightenment.

bread_and_wine.name: Bread and Wine
bread_and_wine.desc: We believe that only a communion which includes both bread and wine is valid, even for lay members. Our clergymen will administer the communion under both kinds to every member of the service.

clerical_poverty.name: Clerical Poverty
clerical_poverty.desc: The Clergy should own no riches and give up their material possessions. They should devote their attention to God rather than the secular world.

crown_as_head_of_faith.name: Crown as Head of Faith
crown_as_head_of_faith.desc: The Church is no longer subject to one external, corrupt theocrat. Instead, all religious issues shall be now redirected to the ruler who serves as the new Head of the Faith.

freedom_to_preach.name: Freedom to Preach
freedom_to_preach.desc: There is much disagreement among the followers, but each sect shall be given the freedom to preach freely so long as God is in their hearts.

gnosticism.name: Gnosticism
gnosticism.desc: Gnosticism centers on personal salvation through gnosis. We will escape the material world and return to a higher realm by seeking spiritual insight.

individual_creeds.name: Individual Creeds
individual_creeds.desc: Allowing our people to formulate their own creeds will encourage the formation of individual opinions and allow to pave the way for the path to progress!

monasticism.name: Monasticism
monasticism.desc: The pleasures of fine food and drink only serve to distract us from service to the divine. Isolating ourselves in remote monasteries is the best way to avoid these temptations.

modalism.name: Modalism
modalism.desc: We believe that God is absolutely one, and the trinitarian concepts like the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit are merely different modes in which God manifests Himself.

organized_through_bishops.name: Appointment of Bishops
organized_through_bishops.desc: Instead of discarding the appointment of bishops entirely, they will serve the Church as the administrators of larger areas.

pacifism.name: Pacifism
pacifism.desc: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called the children of God.

parish_registers.name: Parish Registers
parish_registers.desc: Details of baptisms, marriages, and burials will from now on be documented in a parish register. Each parish priest will keep a book where they will enter these events and keep it in a sure coffer with two locks.

participation_women.name: Participation of Women
participation_women.desc: While women do participate as equals in our communities, we will adopt a general rule everywhere so that they are treated as men are.

rejection_of_sacraments.name: Rejection of Sacraments
rejection_of_sacraments.desc: Our doctrine rejects most Christian sacraments as they are mostly physical and are of no importance. The spiritual part is the only one that matters, to make us closer to God.

sola_fide.name: Sola Fide
sola_fide.desc: No good deed can satisfy God. We are pardoned by the divine grace alone, which God has granted through His only Son, Jesus Christ.

sola_scriptura.name: Sola Scriptura
sola_scriptura.desc: The Bible, the word of God delivered unto man, is the sole authority for Christian doctrine. All religious practices that cannot be supported by Biblical reference are to be denounced as heresy.

soli_deo_gloria.name: Soli Deo Gloria
soli_deo_gloria.desc: All human achievements can only be created with the the praise of God as their dedication.

translated_bibles.name: Translated Bibles
translated_bibles.desc: Translating Bibles to a language the people of our country speak gives them the best pathway to God in a way that speaks to their minds and hearts.

usury_allowed.name: Usury Allowed
usury_allowed.desc: Monetary loans with interest that enrich the lender is now allowed and no longer considered sinful.

war_sermons.name: War Sermons
war_sermons.desc: In times of conflicts, the faith preserves the hope of our people. The Church of our realm will preach from the Holy Book to keep the morale of the population up even during the darkest hours.

adamite_services.desc: The Adamite sect insists upon nakedness during church services. Without the stylings of status or culture, we appear as equals in the eyes of God, a stark reminder of our shared humanity and of the innocence we enjoyed before the Fall.

punishment_of_sin.name: Punishment of Sin
punishment_of_sin.desc: All who sin must be punished equally, no matter wealth or rank. Even the nobility are not above the laws of God.

baptism_by_fire.name: Baptism by Fire
baptism_by_fire.desc: Our faith does not believe that baptims by water is permanent, as Saint John the Baptist admited. It is only by touching the four sides of the head of a person with a burning candle that a permanent baptism can happen.

name_change.name: Name Change
name_change.desc: The power of names is well known by our communities. Our faith leaders often change their names after the names of followers of Saint Paul, as common folks change the name of their settlements to those of places where our patron Saint dwelled.

paulician_canon.name: Paulician Canon
paulician_canon.desc: Our people reject the Old Testament and its Prophets, as they reject the inclusion of the epistles of Saint Peter. Only the words of Saint Paul are appropriate.

punishment_by_stoning.name: Punishment by Stoning
punishment_by_stoning.desc: Stoning is a common practice to punish religious dissidents among our communities that stand out from our neighbors. This is most likely an inheritance from our Anatolian origins.

justified_conflicts.name: Justified Conflicts
justified_conflicts.desc: The new Church of the country is threatened by heathens and heretics alike. In a war of self-preservation, the Church will justify our conflicts with the Bible.

pietism.name: Pietism
pietism.desc: Pietism focuses on the individual piety of every believer and emphasizes the inner transformation that leads to a devout Christian life.
